System Architecture

The FAQ Generator follows a pipeline architecture with the following stages:

Discovery: The discoverer module scans the input folder recursively for supported file
types. It respects a maximum depth of 10 levels and caps at 10,000 files.

Reading: The reader module extracts text from each discovered document. It dispatches
to format-specific handlers based on file extension.

Chunking: The chunker splits extracted text into overlapping chunks of up to 3,000 words.
It attempts to split at sentence boundaries to preserve context.

Generation: The generator sends each chunk to the Claude API with a structured prompt
requesting 3-10 QA pairs per chunk.

Merging: The merger combines all QA pairs in deterministic order sorted by document
path and chunk index.

Deduplication: The deduplicator removes exact and near-duplicate questions using
TF-IDF cosine similarity with a threshold of 0.85.

Output: The writer formats the final QA pairs as Markdown and saves to output/faq.md.
